title: Google Scholar Scraper Input
description: Search Google Scholar papers, list citing papers, or export public author profiles. No account, API key, or proxy setup is needed.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to fetch: paper search, citing papers, or public author profiles.

queries.title: Search Queries
queries.description: Keywords or paper titles to search on Google Scholar (mode=search). Each query runs separately.

clusterIds.title: Cluster IDs or Citing URLs
clusterIds.description: Paper cluster IDs or Google Scholar 'cites=' URLs to list citing papers for (mode=citations).

authorIds.title: Author IDs or Profile URLs
authorIds.description: Google Scholar author IDs or profile URLs to export (mode=authorProfile).

maxItems.title: Maximum Results
maxItems.description: Maximum papers per query or cluster, or papers per author. Google Scholar serves about 10 search results per page.

sortBy.title: Sort By
sortBy.description: Sort search results by relevance or date (mode=search).

filter.title: Document Format
filter.description: Keep only PDF or HTML results; applied to returned rows (mode=search).

articleType.title: Article Type
articleType.description: Return all articles or review articles only (mode=search).

newerThan.title: Published After (Year)
newerThan.description: Only include papers published in this year or later (mode=search).

olderThan.title: Published Before (Year)
olderThan.description: Only include papers published in this year or earlier (mode=search).

author.title: Authored By
author.description: Return papers written by this author, e.g. 'Geoffrey Hinton' (mode=search).

publication.title: Published In
publication.description: Return papers from this journal or venue, e.g. 'Nature' (mode=search).

titleOnly.title: Search Titles Only
titleOnly.description: Match the query against paper titles instead of the full text (mode=search).

includeCitationFormats.title: Include Citation Formats
includeCitationFormats.description: Also return MLA, APA, Chicago, Harvard, and Vancouver citations for returned rows, within a bounded budget (mode=search or citations).

includePaperDetails.title: Include Paper Details
includePaperDetails.description: Fetch journal, volume, pages, publisher, and abstract for each author publication (mode=authorProfile).
